fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Description
fields.help: A free-text description of the resource.

fields.label: Gateways
fields.help: Gateways defines a list of gateways this HttpRoute is attached to, as one of the routing rules to route the requests served by the gateway.

fields.label: Hostnames
fields.help: Set of hosts that should match against the HTTP host header to select a HttpRoute to process the request.

fields.label: Meshes
fields.help: Meshes defines a list of meshes this HttpRoute is attached to, as one of the routing rules to route the requests served by the mesh.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: Name of the HttpRoute resource.

fields.label: Rules
Action
Timeout
fields.help: Specifies the timeout for selected route.

fields.label: Cors Policy
Allow Credentials
fields.help: In response to a preflight request, setting this to true indicates that the actual request can include user credentials.

fields.label: Allow Headers
fields.help: Specifies the content for Access-Control-Allow-Headers header.

fields.label: Allow Methods
fields.help: Specifies the content for Access-Control-Allow-Methods header.

fields.label: Allow Origin Regexes
fields.help: Specifies the regular expression patterns that match allowed origins.

fields.label: Allow Origins
fields.help: Specifies the list of origins that will be allowed to do CORS requests.

fields.label: Disabled
fields.help: If true, the CORS policy is disabled.

fields.label: Expose Headers
fields.help: Specifies the content for Access-Control-Expose-Headers header.

fields.label: Max Age
fields.help: Specifies how long result of a preflight request can be cached in seconds.
The specification for allowing client side cross-origin requests.

fields.label: Destinations
Service Name
fields.help: The URL of a BackendService to route traffic to.

fields.label: Weight
fields.help: Specifies the proportion of requests forwarded to the backend referenced by the serviceName field.
The destination to which traffic should be forwarded.

fields.label: Fault Injection Policy
Abort
Http Status
fields.help: The HTTP status code used to abort the request.

fields.label: Percentage
fields.help: The percentage of traffic which will be aborted.
Specification of how client requests are aborted as part of fault injection before being sent to a destination.

fields.label: Delay
Fixed Delay
fields.help: Specify a fixed delay before forwarding the request.

fields.label: Percentage
fields.help: The percentage of traffic on which delay will be injected.
Specification of how client requests are delayed as part of fault injection before being sent to a destination.
The specification for fault injection introduced into traffic to test the resiliency of clients to backend service failure.

fields.label: Redirect
Host Redirect
fields.help: The host that will be used in the redirect response instead of the one that was supplied in the request.

fields.label: Https Redirect
fields.help: If set to true, the URL scheme in the redirected request is set to https.

fields.label: Path Redirect
fields.help: The path that will be used in the redirect response instead of the one that was supplied in the request.

fields.label: Port Redirect
fields.help: The port that will be used in the redirected request instead of the one that was supplied in the request.

fields.label: Prefix Rewrite
fields.help: Indicates that during redirection, the matched prefix (or path) should be swapped with this value.

fields.label: Response Code
fields.help: The HTTP Status code to use for the redirect.

fields.label: Strip Query
fields.help: If set to true, any accompanying query portion of the original URL is removed prior to redirecting the request.
If set, the request is directed as configured by this field.

fields.label: Request Header Modifier
Remove
fields.help: Remove headers (matching by header names) specified in the list.
The specification for modifying the headers of a matching request prior to delivery of the request to the destination.

fields.label: Request Mirror Policy
Destination
Service Name
fields.help: The URL of a BackendService to route traffic to.

fields.label: Weight
fields.help: Specifies the proportion of requests forwarded to the backend referenced by the serviceName field.
The destination the requests will be mirrored to.
Specifies the policy on how requests intended for the routes destination are shadowed to a separate mirrored destination.

fields.label: Response Header Modifier
Remove
fields.help: Remove headers (matching by header names) specified in the list.
The specification for modifying the headers of a response prior to sending the response back to the client.

fields.label: Retry Policy
Num Retries
fields.help: Specifies the allowed number of retries.

fields.label: Per Try Timeout
fields.help: Specifies a non-zero timeout per retry attempt.

fields.label: Retry Conditions
fields.help: Specifies one or more conditions when this retry policy applies.
Specifies the retry policy associated with this route.

fields.label: URL Rewrite
Host Rewrite
fields.help: Prior to forwarding the request to the selected destination, the requests host header is replaced by this value.

fields.label: Path Prefix Rewrite
fields.help: Prior to forwarding the request to the selected destination, the matching portion of the requests path is replaced by this value.
The specification for rewrite URL before forwarding requests to the destination.
The detailed rule defining how to route matched traffic.

fields.label: Matches
Full Path Match
fields.help: The HTTP request path value should exactly match this value.

fields.label: Ignore Case
fields.help: Specifies if prefixMatch and fullPathMatch matches are case sensitive.

fields.label: Prefix Match
fields.help: The HTTP request path value must begin with specified prefixMatch.

fields.label: Regex Match
fields.help: The HTTP request path value must satisfy the regular expression specified by regexMatch after removing any query parameters and anchor supplied with the original URL.

fields.label: Headers
Exact Match
fields.help: The value of the header should match exactly the content of exactMatch.

fields.label: Header
fields.help: The name of the HTTP header to match against.

fields.label: Invert Match
fields.help: If specified, the match result will be inverted before checking.

fields.label: Prefix Match
fields.help: The value of the header must start with the contents of prefixMatch.

fields.label: Present Match
fields.help: A header with headerName must exist.

fields.label: Regex Match
fields.help: The value of the header must match the regular expression specified in regexMatch.

fields.label: Suffix Match
fields.help: The value of the header must end with the contents of suffixMatch.

fields.label: Range Match
End
fields.help: End of the range (exclusive).

fields.label: Start
fields.help: Start of the range (inclusive).
If specified, the rule will match if the request header value is within the range.
Specifies a list of HTTP request headers to match against.

fields.label: Query Parameters
Exact Match
fields.help: The value of the query parameter must exactly match the contents of exactMatch.

fields.label: Present Match
fields.help: Specifies that the QueryParameterMatcher matches if request contains query parameter, irrespective of whether the parameter has a value or not.

fields.label: Query Parameter
fields.help: The name of the query parameter to match.

fields.label: Regex Match
fields.help: The value of the query parameter must match the regular expression specified by regexMatch.For regular expression grammar, please see https://github.com/google/re2/wiki/Syntax
Specifies a list of query parameters to match against.
A list of matches define conditions used for matching the rule against incoming HTTP requests.
Rules that define how traffic is routed and handled.
